suggestions.rationale: Submission window closed August 6. Need to review all submitted EIPs and make CFI/PFI decisions. Several EIPs already PFI'd (8334, 8341, 8321, 8015, 8148) but may have new submissions.

suggestions.rationale: Targeted for September 2026. With devnet-8 launching early August and public/Mekong-style devnet also planned for early August, need to confirm testing progression and any blocking issues.
